title: Find Australian emergency health sources
short: Australian calls, poisons and dated CPR sources
intro: Australian emergency-call guidance, Queensland poisons advice and dated Sydney Children’s Hospitals Network videos when present. The stored 2025 infant demonstration has a source variation flagged against ANZCOR Guideline 6 on 26 November 2026; qualified clinical review is pending. This is not a complete Australian first-aid manual.
